title: Quarter orchestration playbook for Private/VPC/On‑Prem: rollout sequencing & risk signal framework
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Objective: produce a repeatable quarter-level orchestration playbook that sequences feature launches, upgrade windows, and customer pilots for Private/VPC/on‑prem enterprise deployments. This ticket is the canonical PM artifact for Q2 planning: it includes a dependency matrix, acceptance gates tied to OKRs, a risk-signal framework (what to monitor and thresholds for rollback), and a roll-forward/rollback runbook. The playbook must be consumable by Solutions, SRE, Sales Engineering, and Legal, and link to the technical runbooks maintained by Engineering.

Scope includes: rollout sequencing for v1.3 private agent, VPC network onboarding checklist, automated DB migration strategy for isolated tenants, customer pilot gating criteria, upgrade window policy (maintenance SLA and business-hours considerations), and compliance checklist for KMS/HSM onboarding. Out of scope: building the agent binary or infra provisioning scripts (owned by ENG), but includes acceptance criteria that those deliverables must meet for rollout gating.

Why now: several enterprise customers requested predictable upgrade windows and clear rollback clauses. Sales requires a playbook to include timings and failure budgets for contracts. This aligns to OKR: "Make Private deployments a predictable revenue channel" (PM-Quarterly-OKR-2).
acceptance_criteria: A single playbook doc that sequences features and release gates for the quarter and is approved by SRE/Legal/Sales Engineering
Dependency matrix with owners and mitigation plans for top-10 dependencies
Risk-signal framework with monitoring metrics, alert thresholds, and automated fallback policies described
Customer pilot criteria and runbook validated by Solutions team with at least two pilot customers signed for Q2
Upgrade window policy defined and validated against SLA & sales contract templates
Links to technical runbooks (ENG PRs, Confluence ops pages) included and verified
milestones: Draft playbook v0.1 and dependency matrix — 2026-03-10
Pilot cohort sign-ups & pilot runbooks finalized — 2026-04-07

risks: Network constraints: some customers have restrictive egress rules that may delay agent onboarding (mitigation: preflight network checklist and staged config templates)
Dependency on ENG rollout of agent telemetry: if delayed, cannot validate risk signals (mitigation: fallback synthetic probes and manual validation steps)
Legal/compliance gating: differing KMS/HSM customer policies could require bespoke contract language (mitigation: Legal to pre-author templated addenda)
Limited SRE capacity during sprint overlap could postpone operational runbook hardened testing (mitigation: reserve 2 SRE-days in calendar early)
